title: cyperus pumilus var. leucolepis
intro: Cyperus pumilus var. leucolepis, commonly known as Dwarf Papyrus Sedge, is a type of grass-like plant in the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Papyrus Sedge include being an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, helping to soothe and protect the body from various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
